title: Fixed-Price Line Rebill Credit: Over-Billed Amount and Carrying Credit
content:
On a Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts contract, the pass-through cycle is the cycle that began on the stated effective date of the contract's latest regulatory pass-through notice, and the rebill credit on its fixed-price energy line rests on these clauses:

1. The over-billed amount of the pass-through cycle's fixed-price line is its billed amount less its fixed-price kWh multiplied by the cycle's price in force and divided by 100, that product rounded half up to the cent, and nothing when the difference is not positive.
2. The fixed-price kWh of the fixed-price line correction are the cycle's metered kWh, the kWh on all of the cycle's energy lines together.
3. The cycle's price in force is the new contract price, in cents per kWh, of the latest regulatory pass-through notice, the latest being the one with the latest notice date.
4. The fixed-price line carrying credit is the over-billed amount multiplied by its carrying rate and by its carrying period, where the carrying period is the whole months from the line's posted date to the handling date multiplied by 30 days per month and divided by 360 days per year.
5. The fixed-price line carrying rate is zero.
6. The fixed-price line rebill credit is the over-billed amount plus its carrying credit, rounded half up to the cent and posted as a negative amount.

Whole months are calendar months from the line's posted date, a month being complete on the same day of the month as the posted date.

## Worked through (hypothetical figures, fixed structure)

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| billed amount of the cycle's energy charge line | $31500.00 |
| metered kWh of the cycle | 420000 |
| new contract price on the latest regulatory pass-through notice | 7.20 cents per kWh |
| correct amount: 420000 multiplied by 7.20, divided by 100 | $30240.00 |
| over-billed amount: 31500.00 less 30240.00 | $1260.00 |
| carrying period for a line posted 7 whole months ago: 7 multiplied by 30, divided by 360 | 0.5833 |
| carrying credit at a carrying rate of zero | $0.00 |
| rebill credit | minus $1260.00 |

Where the correct amount is equal to or above the billed amount, the over-billed amount is nothing and no credit is posted.
